The RTX 3090 is here! It has a lot of VRAM, 24GB of GDDR6X. 
This is a review of the MSI Gaming X Trio RTX 3090, compared to NVIDIA Founder's Edition RTX 3080, the RTX 2080 Ti, RTX 2080, GTX 1080 Ti, GTX 1070 and Radeon RX 5700 XT. 

RTX 3090 GPUs @ Amazon (US, and all sold out right now 😭) - https://amzn.to/2HwNEz3
